Privacy policy

How we handle information and how to exercise your rights.

On this pageData controller and contactInformation you provideBrowser-side preferencesTechnical informationPurposes and safeguardsRetention and your choicesExternal websites and transfersContact and complaintsYour rightsExport browser choicesReset browser choices and request erasureCookies

1. Data controller and contact

Rucking Revolution, Norway. Contact us at info@ruckingrevolution.org about privacy and personal data.

2. Information you provide

If you email us, we receive your email address, message and any details you choose to provide. We use these to respond to requests and manage relevant correspondence. The website has no account, newsletter subscription or server-side contact form.

3. Browser-side preferences

Search terms, filters and comparison selections may appear in the page address. Training calculations, crew plans and exports are processed in your browser; they are not submitted to us by these tools. Downloaded files remain on your device. Avoid putting personal information in search terms or shared addresses.

4. Technical information

Vercel hosts the site and may process IP addresses, request times and requested pages for delivery, reliability, abuse prevention and security. The site code contains no analytics or advertising scripts. Provider-side settings and logging are separate from the application code.

5. Purposes and safeguards

We limit information to what is needed to provide the website and respond to correspondence. Service delivery and security may rely on legitimate interests; processing necessary for an agreement or a legal obligation may rely on those respective bases. Where consent is the applicable basis, it can be withdrawn.

6. Retention and your choices

We aim to keep correspondence only as long as necessary for its purpose and applicable legal obligations. Hosting and email records are subject to the relevant provider settings and retention policies. Contact us for specific information about records relating to you.

7. External websites and transfers

Official assessment publishers, organisers, social platforms and publication storefronts have their own policies. Hosting and email providers may process data outside Norway; contact us for information about the safeguards applicable to your data.

8. Contact and complaints

You can contact us to exercise your rights or ask about our handling of information. You can also complain to the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet) or your applicable supervisory authority.

Your rights under GDPR

  • Access your personal data
  • Correct inaccurate data
  • Request erasure
  • Restrict processing
  • Object to certain processing
  • Receive portable data where applicable
  • Withdraw consent where processing relies on consent
  • Request human review where qualifying automated decisions affect you

These rights apply subject to the conditions and exceptions in data protection law. Contact us about your rights or visit Datatilsynet.

Export browser choices

The site does not keep an account or a persistent training log. You can export the current testing-library choices from a shared library link; this does not retrieve provider logs, email records or other personal data. For a data access or portability request, contact us.

Request access or portability

Right to erasure and reset

Open a fresh library with no selected tests or filters. This does not remove browser history, previously downloaded files, hosting records or email correspondence. You can remove history and downloaded files using your browser or device settings. Contact us to request erasure of records we may hold.

Open a fresh library

Prepare an erasure request by email

Cookie preferences

The application does not set preference, analytics or advertising cookies. There are no optional cookie categories to enable in the site. Your browser provides controls for cookies and site data, including any cookies set by external services.
